title: The Parable of the Sower Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Parable of the Sower Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Parable of the Sower Bible crossword: the wayside, stony places, thorns and good ground. KJV clues from Matthew 13, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Four soils, four outcomes, and one of the few parables Jesus explains line by line. The Parable of the Sower works through all four — seed trodden by the wayside and eaten by the fowls, seed on stony places with no deepness of earth, seed among thorns, and seed on good ground bringing forth an hundredfold.

Because the parable comes with its own interpretation attached, the clues can ask about either half: the picture or its meaning. The closing verse is the sentence that sets the sower going out to sow.

clues.text: Where some seeds fell and the fowls devoured them
Places with no deepness of earth
They sprung up and choked the seed
What the good ground brought forth

verseText: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
